text: **The sheet did not override staging.** Every core hit the briefed pose: a side-step, a stride, the hoodie half off. The three rows are near-identical compositions per take. On Codex, the director's state text plus the plate decides the frame, and the sheet decides only the face. reference-admitted-late's replacement failure did not appear, even though Codex has no control over when a reference is admitted. My hypothesis: the sheet is a multi-view card on a neutral field, not a staged shot, and image 1 owns the composition.
